dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the dorsal surface feature thin, high-intensity perimeters with jagged edges, showing a sharp gradient transition from light-toned boundaries to dark-toned interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid dark-pixel spots concentrated on the posterior-lateral flank; low density of isolated high-intensity white pixel clusters located along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent dorsal annuli centroids form an obtuse scalene triangle; a separate cluster of four distinct dark spots on the posterior-lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined parallel linear striations on the visible pectoral flipper create a distinct ribbed texture contrasting against the more amorphous dorsal pattern.
